Welcome to the official channel of Dr. Eric Smith – Practice Growth Strategist

I help chiropractors, physical therapists, and healthcare practice owners automate, scale, and achieve sustainable growth without burning out or sacrificing patient care.

After 14 years as a practicing chiropractor and building multiple six- and seven-figure businesses, I’ve learned how to turn practices into profitable, time-efficient operations using automation, better systems, and high-performing team structures.

Here you’ll find:
✅ Practice growth strategies that drive predictable revenue
✅ Automation tools that give you your time back
✅ Sales and conversion frameworks for healthcare services
✅ Leadership and mindset content to help you scale with confidence

If you're ready to grow your impact, income, and freedom — you’re in the right place.

🎯 Subscribe now and join a community of growth-minded doctors building the next generation of healthcare practices.
